name: Uni
axesStatus: Illustrative equal axes at the radiometric diameter; not three measured axes.
credit: Fornasier et al. (2013), Astronomy & Astrophysics 555, A15; Herschel PACS and SPIRE thermal radiometry
shapeMeaning: Illustrative sphere at the 692 ± 23 km diameter measured from thermal emission. No shape model is published.
orientationMeaning: Illustrative ICRF north pole, arbitrary prime meridian and phase; no spin pole is published.
surfaceMeaning: Unmapped surface: the standard grid is a coordinate aid, not observed colour or terrain.
introduction: Uni is a large icy body in the Kuiper belt beyond Neptune, first catalogued as 2002 UX25.
card: A large icy body in the Kuiper belt.
datasetSummary: A sphere at the 692 km diameter measured from its heat. Shape and pole are not measured.
